claims.claim: F2 fix correctly injects mermaid content between existing markers rather than appending at EOF
claims.evidence: All three F2-relevant invariants hold: (a) fence is between markers (byte-offset proof), (b) outer content byte-identical (sha256 match), (c) mermaid-lint clean. This is the exact contract the F2 fix was meant to enforce.

claims.claim: Title comment `%% Title: Schema` is emitted inside the managed region

suggestions.assertion: Uses `||--o{` for one-to-many edges (matching the input's cardinality)
suggestions.reason: Assertion only checks the `||--o{` token exists somewhere; it would still pass if the edge were reversed (e.g., `Order ||--o{ User`) or connected the wrong entities. Consider anchoring it to `User ||--o{ Order` to verify direction and participants.

No assertion verifies the many-to-many `Order }o--o{ Product : contains` edge from input.json — it is emitted correctly here, but a regression that dropped or corrupted it would not be caught by the current six assertions.

eval_feedback.overall: All six assertions pass with strong byte-level evidence. Two minor sharpening opportunities around cardinality-direction and full edge-set coverage, but the F2 marker-injection contract is thoroughly tested.
